contract: Append and compare-and-set through Ledger only.
Persist policy digest, decision chain, append receipt and independent readback.
No second store or file journal.
expectedBehavior: A1 exposes ports and creates no persistence implementation.
payload.reason: Policy decisions and AI case records require the existing sole durable persistence owner.
tests: Restart, replay, conflict, corruption, backup and restore fail closed.
Decision-log delivery or readback loss blocks green.

contract: Bind distinct runtime, repair and verifier principals.
Retain only non-secret credential references.
Deny inheritance, cross-role fallback and advisor credentials.
expectedBehavior: No subscription or API credential enters the application, browser, repository or worker context.
payload.reason: Three isolated worker identities and the human owner require default-deny role binding.
tests: Prove revocation, cross-identity denial and credential non-exposure.
Unknown identity and stale binding deny.

contract: Mount only accepted test commands and necessary dependencies.
Preserve exact lockfile and offline behavior.
expectedBehavior: No hidden install, lifecycle script, provider call or unreviewed package.
payload.reason: A1 cannot alter shared test scripts, dependencies or lockfiles.
payload.targetSeam: Root and workspace package scripts and lockfiles
tests: Lockfile integrity, license, vulnerability and dependency-necessity checks.
Focused tests run without provider or network access.

contract: Add AI_OPS namespaced entries under the immutable maximum-authority envelope.
Require atomic compare-and-set ControlChangeSet, owner approval and readback.
Delegate J and K effects to existing owners.
expectedBehavior: All A1 entries remain NOT_WIRED until handlers and canonical readback exist.
No UI or A1 artifact becomes authority.
payload.reason: The 120 AI_OPS entries must extend the existing control registry without a second registry.
tests: Prove preview, hash, TTL, stale revision, atomicity, rollback and independent readback.
All hard denials remain unreachable with every safe control enabled.

contract: Register each action separately with lease, fence, idempotency, bounds and postconditions.
Never create an AI executor.
expectedBehavior: Unsigned A1 templates grant no authority.
Effects run only through existing owners after acceptance.
payload.reason: Class-A runbooks need owner-ratified execution through existing command and remediation seams.
payload.targetSeam: Product Assurance remediation campaign and existing effect owners
tests: Prove retries, conflict graph, restart checkpoint, quiet period and recurrence quarantine.
Forbidden and money-adjacent actions deny.

contract: Validate exact owner, release, tested commit, subject and digest tuples.
Keep S6 and AI Ops action-class dialects separate.
expectedBehavior: Reference artifacts never mint live green or acceptance.
payload.reason: A1 reuses S6 evidence grammar and Atlas truth but cannot promote synthetic or generated evidence.
payload.targetSeam: Failure Atlas and diagnostic-boundary owner adapters
tests: Hostile substitution, splice, empty corpus and fixture-promotion tests.
Unknown owner or catalog remains UNKNOWN or MISSING.

contract: Update canonical state only from accepted SHA and mounted interfaces.
Amend authority map only if ownership actually changes.
expectedBehavior: Shadow artifacts remain SHADOW_SPECULATIVE and absent from canonical component status.
payload.reason: Exclusive A1 scope forbids canonical state and ownership documentation changes.
tests: Compare accepted path and SHA manifests to documentation.
Reject premature or duplicate-owner claims.

contract: Export only accepted lane contracts after port and revalidation.
Keep imports pure and acyclic.
expectedBehavior: No cross-lane export exists from this shadow packet.
payload.reason: A1 owns no cross-lane barrel or registry.
tests: Duplicate contract, overlap, purity and exact accepted-manifest scans.

contract: Ratify exactly one incident policy owner while Ledger remains persistence only.
Expose typed admission projection after ratification.
expectedBehavior: INCIDENT_OWNER_NOT_CONFIGURED remains explicit until an owner receipt exists.
payload.reason: The base has no ratified canonical incident owner.
payload.targetSeam: Canonical incident identity, fingerprint, severity and lifecycle owner
tests: Grouping, split, merge, reopen, close, acknowledgement races, dedupe and persistence.
Missing owner cannot become green.

contract: Bind append sequence, hash chain, signed checkpoints and receipt references through existing persistence.
Workers cannot rewrite, delete or administer audit delivery.
expectedBehavior: Assurance level stays explicit; HASH_CHAIN is never mislabeled as a transparency receipt.
payload.reason: Local hash chains alone do not prove completeness or prevent equivocation.
payload.targetSeam: Ledger append plus independently administered audit delivery
tests: Tamper, deletion, reorder, fork, delivery loss, retention expiry and restore.
Missing receipt and readback block green.

contract: Bind exact artifact, parameters, principal, expiry, policy and execution readback.
AI and service identities cannot satisfy owner approval.
expectedBehavior: Unsigned runbooks and policy bundles remain ineligible for activation.
payload.reason: Neither A1 nor command preview can approve elevated proposals or sign runbooks.
payload.targetSeam: Typed human approval request and receipt owner
tests: Expiry, replay, substitution, self-approval, inherited-chat and role-confusion failures.

contract: Default to NOT_CONFIGURED.
Store only non-secret identity, provider, budget and endpoint references.
Never silently change billing domain.
expectedBehavior: Missing or unverifiable provider truth stays NOT_CONFIGURED or DIAGNOSTIC_PLANE_UNAVAILABLE.
payload.reason: Provider states, identity bindings and budgets need explicit revocable configuration.
payload.targetSeam: Server config and I00 non-secret deployment bindings
tests: Invalid config, redaction, round trip, deconfiguration, auth-mode conflict and no-secret scans.

contract: Register the accepted focused suite in canonical root acceptance.
Regenerate Product Assurance operation manifest only from the accepted ported SHA.
Retain exact real exit codes.
expectedBehavior: Current aggregate PRODUCT_ASSURANCE_OPERATION_SCAN_INVALID is an expected integration blocker, never hidden.
payload.reason: Root scripts do not discover test/aiOps/contracts and the operation manifest pins the pre-A1 scan count.
payload.targetSeam: package.json test gates, I00 acceptance and Product Assurance operation manifest
tests: Focused, network-denied, root, complete acceptance and hostile false-green gates.
Verify exact changed paths and scan count.
